what: The verify_supported CLI imports ttnn and fails with ImportError: libtt_metal.so undefined symbol MPIX_Comm_shrink unless .tt_chip_scope is sourced (it sets LD_PRELOAD to the MPIX stub). eval_test_runner.sh sources it internally, the bare CLI command in the prompt does not.
suggest: Prefix the documented CLI with `source .tt_chip_scope &&` or have eval_test_runner.sh run verify_supported itself.

ref: verifier prompt: § Perf refinements (gate on device-ns)
what: Perf refinements are gated on device kernel ns only. For knobs that add kernels or per-core RT args the kernel metric inverts: num_write_lanes=2 cut p1 kernel time 2110->1875 ns but raised trace-replay cost 5952->6229 ns/op. Following the prompt literally would file the lane knob as a win.
suggest: State that any lever changing kernel count, core ranges or RT-arg volume must also hold a trace-replay ns/op no-regression gate.

ref: verifier prompt: § Grouping refinements / Anchor the first two refinements / 2:1 cadence
what: Queue-shape rules (3-5 generality refinements, R1+R2 land the perf contract, perf in slot 3) assume a TARGET gap larger than one refinement. Here the whole gap was three knob-turn SUPPORTED values the perf target needs together. Whether to split them to keep the cadence or file one generality refinement then perf is left to inference from the exhausted-candidates clause.
suggest: Add an explicit rule: when the entire TARGET gap fits one refinement, file it as Refinement 1 and start perf at Refinement 2. Do not split to fill the cadence.
